services.name: Parasailing - Shackleford Banks
services.desc: Aerial Views of Shackleford Banks and Fort Macon Booking Options Private Parasail for up to 6 seats: $395.00 Or Per Person Booking Flyer (Ages 6+): $95.00 Observer (All Ages): $45.00 5% Early Bird Flyer Discount 9:00-11:00 Observers can upgrade to a Flyer during the trip Duration Tour on the water 1~1.5 hr. Each Flight is 10-12 minutes based on 6 flyers About This trip features unmatched sky views of Rachel Carson Reserve, Shackleford Banks and Fort Macon. Trips are fully guided with small group sizes of 6 or less - Health and Safety is our #1 priority!
